summary: L-4 tower built on Peterson Point in St. Joe National Forest in 1938 and destroyed in 1954; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1954; no source describes remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as hike-in; no source describes the site today or whether visitors may go there

evidence.supports: L-4 tower built in 1938 and destroyed in 1954
Nine miles south of St. Maries
Coordinates and tower marked as gone in the regional register
Separate Peterson Point camp in the Nez Perce National Forest, abandoned in 1941

notes_for_editor: Two detailed sources agree on the 1938 build, the 1954 destruction, St. Joe National Forest, Benewah County and 4,161 feet; the regional register confirms the coordinates and that the tower is gone. The brief's record matches these sources, so no corrections. Do not confuse this site with the Peterson Point camp in Idaho County on the Nez Perce National Forest (firelookout.com/id/petersonpoint.html, 1937 camp, abandoned 1941) or the Selway-region Peterson Point page on Idaho Fire Lookouts; neither is this lookout. No staffing, fire or access information was found; Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history.
